statement: Prove that critical bond percolation on Z^2 at p = 1/2 is conformally invariant in the scaling limit (Cardy's formula and convergence of interfaces to SLE(6)), as is known on the triangular lattice by Smirnov.
status_search: Bounded search 2026-09-07: no proof of conformal invariance on Z^2 found; the problem is listed as open in Duminil-Copin's ICM 2018 survey as well (dedup with that source).
title: Conformal invariance of critical bond percolation on the square lattice
